purpose: Teach: アラスカ/アインシュタイン/トライアル/電話機/ブーツ/石鹸/キャスター/セレクト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アラスカで野生のクマ見たいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you want to see wild bears in Alaska, don't you?
lines.style: Light, knowing tease with genuine curiosity underneath. Quick rhythm, almost playful. Testing him a little — she already knows the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、物理でアインシュタインの単元、苦戦したろ?桜
lines.en: You struggled with the Einstein unit in physics, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle tease right back. A small smile in the voice. Comfortable timing — not landing it too hard, just reminding her he notices things too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、新しいゲームのトライアル版、やってみろ
lines.en: Riku, try the new game trial version.
lines.style: Direct but not commanding. A half-suggestion disguised as an order. She wants him to say yes without having to ask nicely. Slight challenge in it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家の電話機まだ使ってるか?桜
lines.en: You still use the home phone at your house, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual observation. Genuinely curious rather than mocking. Soft rhythm. The tone of someone filing away another small fact about someone he's paying attention to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ブーツ買ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you bought some boots, didn't you?
lines.style: Noticing something new about him. Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Not making a big deal of it, but the fact that she saw it and mentioned it says everything.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新しい石鹸の匂い、いいな、桜
lines.en: You know, that new soap smells really good, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. Genuine — not flattering, just genuine observation. A little vulnerable in how unguarded the compliment is. Soft delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、キャスターになりたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you want to be a caster, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, probing gently. She's asking something that matters to him. The question opens a door rather than closes one. Slight rise at the end — inviting him to share.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コンビニで弁当セレクト、いつも迷うな、桜
lines.en: You always hesitate when you're picking out a bento at the convenience store, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Affectionate teasing. Close, familiar. Small laugh underneath. She's caught him in a tiny harmless contradiction and is enjoying letting him know she sees him.
